message:
We all know that feeling of wishing we’d been a bit more prepared when life throws us a curveball. 🚗 This resource from Ready.gov is a gentle reminder that when it comes to being ready on the road, it’s never too late to start thinking ahead. From emergency kits to important documents, it offers practical tips to make sure we’re not left scrambling when the unexpected happens. 

Let’s take a moment to reflect on our own preparedness – have you thought about what you’d need in your car for a surprise detour? We’d love to hear your tips!
